bio.text: Devon Wood is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 17 and has served in the Iowa House since 2023.
The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Wood as a farmer, born in 1996 in Maryville, Missouri, raised in New Market and living there, and a graduate of Shenandoah Community High School.

It also lists Wood as a former chair of the Iowa Federation of College Republicans, a former clerk for Iowa Reps. Clel Baudler and Mary Ann Hanusa, and a member of the Iowa Board of Nursing Home Administrators.
